src='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    sep=next(i for i,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0] not in (0,5,9))
    base=g[sep][0]
    bg=next((v for row in g for v in row if v not in (base,)),None)
    # The non-background object is the only color apart from the separator and field background.
    counts={v:sum(row.count(v) for row in g) for v in set(x for row in g for x in row)}
    obj=max((v for v in counts if v!=base), key=lambda v:counts[v])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==obj]
    top=min(r for r,c in cells); bot=max(r for r,c in cells)
    if bot<sep:
        shift=sep-1-bot
        newcells=[(r+shift,c) for r,c in cells]
        mark=top+shift-1
    else:
        shift=sep+1-top
        newcells=[(r+shift,c) for r,c in cells]
        mark=bot+shift+1
    for r,c in cells:g[r][c]=5 if 5 in counts else 0
    for r,c in newcells:g[r][c]=obj
    g[mark]=[8]*w
    return g
'''
